status.label: Needs Task Manager / elevation details
status.detail: The report gives a narrow repro (Task Manager focused blocks Mouse Without Borders), but it omits a bug-report ZIP, elevation state, second-machine context, and whether the same behavior appears with other admin windows.

next_action.label: Request focused Mouse Without Borders diagnostics
next_action.reason: Need to separate a Task Manager integrity/elevation boundary from a broader cross-machine input regression before proposing a fix.

actions.label: Ask for admin-state and repro details

comment.body: Thanks for the clear Task Manager repro. Could you attach a fresh Report Bug ZIP and confirm a few details: are PowerToys / Mouse Without Borders running elevated on both machines, does the same block happen with any other admin/elevated apps, does it change if Task Manager is opened in elevated mode, and what are the Windows builds on both devices? That will tell us whether this is a Task Manager integrity-boundary issue or a broader Mouse Without Borders input regression.

actions.note: Draft only; no upstream comment is posted without explicit approval.

judgment.rationale: The symptom is concrete, but the current report is still missing the admin/elevation context that would distinguish a by-design security boundary from a genuine Mouse Without Borders regression.
evidence: The reporter says Mouse Without Borders stops working only while Task Manager is focused.
The issue lists Windows 11 Insider Preview in Additional Information but provides no bug-report ZIP, no assignee, no comments, and no linked PRs/issues.
The report does not say whether PowerToys is running elevated or whether the same behavior happens with other elevated or secure-desktop-adjacent windows.
judgment.recommended_action: Collect a bug report plus elevation and cross-app repro details before committing engineering time.
